question: What share of the chloroplast genome do the two inverted repeats make up together?
rendered:
The two inverted repeats make up 26,575 base pairs each, which together make up 53,150 base pairs of the chloroplast genome. The total size of the chloroplast genome is 157,274 base pairs. 

Therefore, the two inverted repeats make up approximately 33.8% of the chloroplast genome.
